ruleDefinitions.name: Clipboard Data Collection Via OSAScript
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects possible collection of data from the clipboard via execution of the osascript binary

sequences.query: (process_command_line = RGX(".*osascript.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-e\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*clipboard.*"))
